words.note: faster-whisper base.en on 'The word is X.' (lead-in synthesised by the same voice); biased proxy, 'miss' means 'listen to this one'

phrases.note: whole clip transcribed, expected words looked up in the transcript; proxy only

consonant_frame_test.note: lone sound spliced in front of the voice's own 'in'; crude, biased, advisory only

caveats: Nobody has listened to this audio. All checks are measurements.
faster-whisper base.en is a biased intelligibility proxy only. It is not a naturalness measure and it cannot tell whether a sound teaches the right phoneme to a child.
